title: First-use hint rules
description: GH-345 follow-up. One-line contextual hints for the lessons the tutorial no longer teaches. Each rule is shown on the HUD's hint line the first time ALL of its conditions hold, for a few seconds, once per profile (localStorage 'lions.seen.hints'). Read by @lions/app only, never by the sim. `key` is an i18n catalogue key, never prose.

id.description: The memory key; renaming one re-shows it to everyone.

key.description: i18n key of the one-line text.

keys.description: Key-cap parameters of the text: {param name: keymap action id}, resolved live so a rebind keeps the hint true.

mission.description: Only in these missions. Absent: any mission.

selected_type.description: A selected unit has one of these unit type ids.

selected_over.description: More than this many units are selected.

force_over.description: The player fields more than this many living units.

carrier_empty_seat.description: A selected carrier has a free seat.

resources.description: The mission has a logistics economy.
